description: Find companies by name or keywords, place and size, up to 50 a page. Each result has the company's id, page, industry, place and followers; linkedin/company gives the whole page, and linkedin/employees its people. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

company_size.description: Only companies of these sizes, as LinkedIn bands them: `1-10`, `11-50`, `51-200`, `201-500`, `501-1000`, `1001-5000`, `5001-10000`, `10001+`. Several, comma-separated.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

name: search_linkedin_companies
title: Search companies on LinkedIn
